name: tradepilot212
description: Trading 212 portfolio analytics, performance and income reports, market hours, and human-confirmed order review over a local MCP server.

t212_demo_api_key.title: Trading 212 Demo API key
t212_demo_api_key.description: Practice-account key. Leave empty if unused.

t212_demo_api_secret.title: Trading 212 Demo API secret
t212_demo_api_secret.description: Shown once when you create the Demo key.

t212_live_api_key.title: Trading 212 Live API key
t212_live_api_key.description: Real-money key. A key without order permissions keeps the plugin read-only at the broker.

t212_live_api_secret.title: Trading 212 Live API secret
t212_live_api_secret.description: Shown once when you create the Live key.

default_environment.title: Default environment
default_environment.description: Used when a request does not say demo or live.

allow_writes.title: Enable order tools
allow_writes.description: Off by default. When on, the model can draft orders and the order execution tools become callable; only enable it in a host that asks you before each tool call.

max_order_notional.title: Max order value
max_order_notional.description: Per-order value cap in the instrument currency. 0 disables it.
